lines: Day eight. Your shells fell all night.
open
Hegemony three hundred and eighty-three shells. Concord three hundred and one.
shells
Shell after shell found the concrete. Four in ten Concord pillboxes are rubble.
destroy
Oskar Guyy studied medicine before the war. Here he was soldier and doctor at once.
rifle
He was killed on watch. His rifle still pointed where the shot came from.
rifle2
Eighteen Concord men fell. The Hegemony lost one. With the concrete gone, the spotters on Hill 304 saw every head.
toll
Chaplain Gideon Vylet was shot at dawn. His tea was still hot.
tea
Blackwater Canal. The Hegemony lead, thirty-two to twenty-nine.
race
Edmund Mcnamara and Walter Wizzerd joined the Officers' Mess. A gold star now hangs over their soldiers.
stars
Thirty-two new soldiers yesterday. Five hundred and two now hold the front.
army
Tomorrow, two of you will fly. Comment PILOT under our pilot reel.
pilot
